calls.actual_prompt_snapshot: One standalone 1376x768 landscape wordless comic panel, one simultaneous moment, NOT a page/collage. Match the references accepted delicate semi-realistic painterly CG, fine hair, softly blended skin, dimensional fabric, muted natural light. Nine-year-old SU LI: same ruby eyes, long wavy silver-grey hair/white flower clip, ivory knit cardigan/cotton dress, dusty-blue ribbon, white socks/Mary Janes. Adult mother JIANG YUEYAN: same grey eyes, half-up silver-grey hair, pearl studs, navy high-neck long-sleeved dress. Twelve-year-old QIN YIN: same grey-blue eyes, long straight SIDE-PARTED black hair, no blunt bangs, plain ivory long-sleeved cotton dress. Attending doctor: adult man, short black hair, rectangular glasses, plain white coat/dark clothes. Same wooden hut/open LEFT door at NIGHT, small warm lamplight/cool dark ambient, no rain/mansion. Girl keeps muddy ivory outfit and oversized dusty-PINK adult wool coat around shoulders, LEFT arm protected. Mothers navy clothes/pearls unchanged, half-up hair slightly loosened from searching. Girl keeps oversized dusty-PINK wool coat on shoulders. SHOT: Mother has just FOUND and securely embraced Su Li, visibly shaken and tearful. Her gaze falls to the girls sore LEFT forearm which is still unbandaged; doctor approaches to inspect, Qin Yin stands a few steps back anxiously. Pink coat remains loosely over girl without hiding the protected arm. No accusation verdict, no fixed splint yet, no adoption cancellation. Preserve faces and key hands/objects. Only named cast, modest nonsexual schoolchildren, no adult redesign. NO text, signs, numbers, logo, watermark, balloon, blank text box, border, physical system/UI, animal ears/tails, gore, injury-causing action or medical tutorial.
